supersedes_policy_only: Add efficiency guard to same opt-in bounded tactical search; original plan and first receipts preserved.
reason: Initial exposed-only probe finds unchanged choices, root completeddepth2->1, and even baseline Ng5-position depth0 at10k. Additional quiet search needs bounded quiescence cost.
revision: Within opt-in UseQuiescenceThreats, skip SEE<0 captures only at nonchecked, nondefensive qnodes; keep checking captures, promotions, en-passant, all evasions and all legal forced-defense responses. Zero threshold fixed by local material exchange, no parameter grid.
known_limitations: SEE pruning is a selective heuristic and can miss nonchecking sacrifices with later compensation. Correctness of chess legality and state restoration does not prove equality to exhaustive minimax.
